 Formula One 2026 United States Grand Prix: Formula One – live
 🏎️ Updates from Austin; race start 3pm CDT/8pm GMT
 🏎️ Antonelli seizes US GP pole | Mail Tom with your thoughts
 LIVE  Updated  50s ago Tom Lutz Sun 25 Oct 2026 17.35 EDT First published on Sun 25 Oct 2026 15.00 EDT Share Key events 2h ago What Antonelli needs to clinch the title today 
 2h ago The grid 
 3h ago Preamble 
 Kimi Antonelli leds the Grand Prix in Austin. Photograph: Mike Segar/Reuters View image in fullscreen Kimi Antonelli leds the Grand Prix in Austin. Photograph: Mike Segar/Reuters Tom Lutz Sun 25 Oct 2026 17.35 EDT First published on Sun 25 Oct 2026 15.00 EDT Share Key events 2h ago What Antonelli needs to clinch the title today 
 2h ago The grid 
 3h ago Preamble 
 now 17.35 EDT Lap 54/56: Bottas’s car is lifted off and the virtual safety car is done. We will finish this race … in an actual race.
 Share 2m ago 17.33 EDT Lap 53/56: Bottas pulls off the track, his car can’t be immediately be moved and the virtual safety car is out. Antonelli had a huge lead anyway, but this race could end in a procession.
 Share 4m ago 17.30 EDT Lap 52/56: Latest standings:
 1) Antonelli
 2) Leclerc
 3) Verstappen
 4) Hamilton
 5) Norris
 6) Hadjar
 7) Piastri
 8) Russell
 Share 5m ago 17.30 EDT Lap 51/56: Hamilton overtakes Norris and is into fourth. That means his title chances will stay alive today if he stays in fourth.
 Share 6m ago 17.29 EDT Lap 50/56: There’s an outside chance to Hamilton getting a podium here. He’s gaining on Norris in fourth and Max is really having to battle to control his car in third.
 Share 8m ago 17.27 EDT Lap 49/56: Leclerc dives past Verstappen after a wide turn at 11, and the Monaco driver is up to second. He’s had a great drive today.
 Share 9m ago 17.26 EDT Lap 48/56: While there’s action further back, Antonelli rolls (very quickly on). His lead over second-placed Verstappen is 16.3 seconds. Neither man is set to pit again today.
 Share 11m ago 17.24 EDT Lap 47/56: Verstappen continues to nibble at Norris, then slips past and is now second. Leclerc tries to pass Norris too but the Englishman hangs on … for now. And on the next turn, Norris locks up and Leclerc passes nicely and into third place.
 Share 13m ago 17.22 EDT Lap 46/56: Standings with 10 laps to go:
 1) Antonelli
 2) Norris
 3) Verstappen
 4) Leclerc
 5) Hamilton
 6) Hadjar
 7) Piastri
 8) Russell
 Share 14m ago 17.21 EDT Lap 45/56: Verstappen is closing on second-placed Norris.
 Share 17m ago 17.18 EDT Lap 44/56: Russell still has a healthy lead over ninth-place Lawson (around 28 seconds) meaning the title race is likely to continue into the next GP as things stands.
 Share 18m ago 17.16 EDT Lap 43/56: First-place Antonelli, who won’t pit again unless something goes very wrong, leads Norris in second by 14.7sec.
 Share 20m ago 17.15 EDT Lap 42/56: Hamilton battling Hadjar for fifth. He has a few darts and is held off by Hadjar until the Englishman finally overtakes him.
 Share 22m ago 17.13 EDT Lap 41/56: Lewis Hamilton records the fastest lap of the race. Watch this kid, he could be going places.
 Share 23m ago 17.11 EDT Lap 40/56: Leclerc pits. Current standings: 
 1) Antonelli
 2) Norris
 3) Verstappen
 4) Leclerc
 5) Hadjar
 6) Hamilton
 7) Piastri
 8) Russell
 Share 25m ago 17.10 EDT Lap 39/56: Hamilton pits – almost certainly his final one of the day – and reenters in sixth. He needs to finish fourth or higher to keep his championship hopes alive.
 Share 26m ago 17.09 EDT Lap 38/56: Russell and Piastri are having a battle for seventh. Russell still comfortably ahead of Lawson, who is ninth – that gap is around 27 seconds. 
 Share 27m ago 17.08 EDT Lap 37/56: Franco Colapinto retires. Antonelli gets a track limits violation as he tries to lap Sainz.
 Share 30m ago 17.05 EDT Lap 36/56: Verstappen was reporting problems a while back but seems to be more comfortable now. Proof that if you just ignore your problems in life they’ll magically sort themselves out at some point.
 Share 31m ago 17.04 EDT Lap 35/56: Russell is in eighth, meaning the title race will (nominally) continue into the Mexican GP next week. Russell looks fairly comfortable too, so he probably won’s slip back down the field.
 Share 32m ago 17.02 EDT Lap 34/56: Antonelli’s lead over Leclerc is 1.7sec.
 View image in fullscreen 
 Photograph: Kaylee Greenlee/Reuters Share Updated at  17.09 EDT 33m ago 17.01 EDT Lap 33/56: Latest standings: 
 1) Antonelli
 2) Leclerc
 3) Hamilton
 4) Norris
 5) Verstappen
 6) Hadjar
 7) Piastri
 8) Russell
 Share 36m ago 16.58 EDT Lap 32/56: “Front wing update please, Max,” he’s asked on the radio. His not entirely encouraging reply: “No idea, mate.” Verstappen pits and it’s a slow one. He reenters the race in fifth. For now, Leclerc leads over Antonelli, but the Italian will not pit again this race. And … he overtakes Leclerc to regain the lead anyway. A comfortable, nerveless race from the 20-year-old.
 Share 39m ago 16.56 EDT Lap 31/56: Russell is up to eighth – and Hamilton is fourth – which means Kimi would not win the title today, even if he finishes in first.
 Share 40m ago 16.55 EDT Lap 30/56: Verstappen is on the radio saying he’s having a problem with his car. He can’t hear what his engineer is saying though. So put that down as two problems: his engine and his radio. It’s looking good for Antonelli.
 Share 41m ago 16.53 EDT Lap 29/56: A bad day for Bearman. He serves his 10-second penalty and then retires from the race.
 Share 44m ago 16.51 EDT Lap 28/56: Standings at the halfway point:
 1) Verstappen
 2) Leclerc
 3) Antonelli
 4) Hamilton
 5) Norris
 6) Hadjar
 Share Updated at  16.51 EDT 45m ago 16.49 EDT Lap 27/56: As things stand, Antonelli will be ahead of Verstappen when Max pits.
 Share 46m ago 16.48 EDT Lap 26/56: Hadjar pits and Kimi moves up to third. Hamilton is fourth, which means Antonelli would not win the title if he goes on to clinch this race today.
 Share 49m ago 16.46 EDT Lap 25/56: Antonelli pits! And he reenters in fourth but he won’t pit again this race, whereas everyone else ahead of him will. The Italian remains the favourite for this race.
 View image in fullscreen Kimi Antonelli goes into the pits. Photograph: Dustin Safranek/AFP/Getty Images Share Updated at  16.54 EDT 50m ago 16.45 EDT Lap 24/56: Verstappen is 13 seconds behind Antonelli in first. Hadjar did not like having to let Max through into second but was quickly told by the team where to stick his feelings.
 Share 51m ago 16.44 EDT Lap 23/56: Russell pits and serves his five-second penalty while he’s at it. He reenters the race in 10th. That means – as things stand with Russell in 10th and Hamilton in fifth – that Antonelli would win the title if he wins the race today. But things are likely to change between now and then. Verstappen moves into second.
 Share 54m ago 16.41 EDT Lap 22/56: Verstappen in now in third. He’s set to pit once more this race, as is the leader, Antonelli. The gap between first and third is around 14 seconds.
 Share Updated at  16.41 EDT 55m ago 16.39 EDT Lap 21/56: Leclerc, who has had an excellent race today, overtakes Russell and is now in fourth. Russell, remember, needs to finish outside the top eight for Antonelli to have a chance of clinching the title today.
 Share 1h ago 16.38 EDT Lap 20/56: The Ferraris edge up to fifth (Leclerc) and sixth (Hamilton). Leclerc also sets the fastest lap of the race so far.
